entry.title: Reorganised the catalogue by reader question: rebuilt Home and the Use cases, Alternatives, Products and Where-to-use hubs, extended What is Jev, and kept every earlier URL and report.
New page: Jev API access status with a dated timeline; signups reopened 27 Sep, new-user free credit disabled.
New page: official TypeSafe surfaces, a five-step check and lookalike reseller prices (3–16× list price).
New page and worksheet tool: cost per decision from your own input-token counts, with third-party token measurements.
New page: version-pinned Python example for typesafe-sdk 0.7.2, a tested-offline retry client and 12 gotchas.
New page: documented vs reported error codes, request limits, gateway differences and a fallback procedure.
New page: what Jev's confidence fields mean, a formula check on documented examples, calibration tests and a seven-step cutoff procedure.
New page: 17 limitations TypeSafe documents for Jev 1.13, with workarounds, and the explained fit check.
New page: 46 demo videos in 13 use-case groups, each linked to the creator-marked start of the demo.
Route matrix: Vercel's exact $0.042/M and ZDR none, OpenRouter /api/v1/systemone, new Jev Router row, Opper 64K context.
Products: added a production-claims ledger; relabelled two rows from the unofficial TypeSafeAI community organisation as not TypeSafe official.
Alternatives: added Ollaya and Jevper rows, updated Kev and Laya, and listed six unchecked leads.
Added the release 1 research report and moved Research into the Evidence group with release notes, URL map, evidence gaps and the daily scan summary.
Updated home, use cases, products and Jev explainer with source-path distinctions for Jevmail, WordPress and QuantDinger; separated code policy and mocked tests from live use.
Added dated implementation-path audit, exact 27–28 September monitor window, file/test ledger, route check and native-feed limitations; retained all twelve earlier reports.

Updated current Vercel Jev provider-row display to rounded $0.04/M input from historical 26 Sep Free; kept exact tariff, free-credit eligibility and bill unverified. Rechecked other routes and data terms.
Added QuantDinger only as a creator-documented optional Jev entry gate with fail-open, exit bypass and no verified live Jev or trade; updated Jevmail and Jev Trade checks.
Added dated seven-day access and daily-discovery report with fixed monitor window, comparison and discovery limits; kept all eleven historical reports.
On 26 Sep, Vercel still displayed Free despite its stated 25 Sep Jev promotion end; effective post-promotion rate and eligibility remain unknown.
Replaced dashboard-only Jev price note with Cloudflare’s Jev-specific $0.042/M input and $0 output/cached input list.
